reason: The ContentstackProvider stores content as a static useMemo value from SSR defaultContent and never subscribes to Contentstack Live Preview's onEntryChange callback to re-render with updated content. The Stack in src/services/contentstack.ts already configures live_preview.enable=true, but no code wires Stack.onEntryChange to update this context — so live preview data flows into the SDK but never reaches React components.
fix: Install @contentstack/live-preview-utils, import it, and in ContentstackProvider: (1) add a React state for content initialized from defaultContent, (2) call livePreviewUtils.onEntryChange(callback) on mount to receive live preview updates and setState with the merged content, (3) replace the useMemo with the state value so re-renders propagate to all useContent consumers. The onEntryChange callback receives the updated entry data from Contentstack's live preview SDK which should be merged into the existing content structure and set as the new state.
